messages:
jamie: Quick note — runtime onboarding guide (docs/runtime/onboarding.md) has a dead anchor: '#kv-cache-prefetch' returns 404 in link-checker :grimacing: I hit it in onboarding flow test. Anyone owns that page?

 tanya: Can you paste the failing link? I can take this if it's a small fix.

 jamie: sure — the link is https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/onboarding#kv-cache-prefetch and the heading in the doc is 'KV cache (prefetch)'. Looks like the anchor id got normalized to 'kv-cache-prefetching' or similar. Here's the failing line from the link-checker:

 `Broken link: /docs/runtime/onboarding.md#kv-cache-prefetch -> 404`

 oscar: If it's just anchor rename we can sed replace header ID across guides. Jamie — any pattern for the new id?

 jamie: header currently:

 ```markdown
 ### KV cache prefetching
 ```

 so anchor is `kv-cache-prefetching`. I think previous anchor was `kv-cache-prefetch`. Quick fix is to add explicit HTML anchor or adjust link. I'd prefer to update the link to the canonical heading.

 tanya: I'll open a tiny PR to replace the link in the onboarding page + runtime examples that reference it. Using this sed locally to confirm:

 ```bash
 rg "kv-cache-prefetch" -n docs/ | xargs -I{} sed -i "s/kv-cache-prefetch/kv-cache-prefetching/g" {}
 ```

 oscar: Heads up — run the docs link-checker CI after PR, it should catch remaining refs. Also add a redirect rule? Maybe just update links first.

 liam: assigning to @tanya for the PR. Add `eng-docs` label and request review from @oscar. I'll queue a quick link-check run when it's merged.

 tanya: Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1987 — small replace, tests passing locally. Marking as ready for review.

 devex-bot: PR 1987 opened by tanya — status: open, checks: pending.

 oscar: quick look — LGTM, small nit inline. :thumbsup: 

 tanya: fixed nit, pushed. Please review when you get a sec.

 oscar: Approved. :shipit: 

 liam: Thanks all. I'll trigger link-checker after merge. Noted for the next docs sweep to watch for anchor drift.

 jamie: Thanks @tanya! saved my onboarding test run. :pray:
